meta.title: perf: cache GetRuntimeData usage for improved performance
meta.body_summary: Cache GetRuntimeData/GetVRRuntimeData calls to eliminate repeated pointer arithmetic and VR checks, claiming performance improvement in the Skyrim Community Shaders mod.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot proposed caching GetRuntimeData calls but after review and self-analysis found minimal actual performance benefit; PR closed without merge after maintainer questioned evidence of hot path.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 163 changed lines across 10 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted performance PR that attempted to cache function calls. It was closed—not merged—because the actual performance benefit was deemed minimal and no benchmark evidence was provided.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer alandtse CHANGES_REQUESTED asking to handle other similar examples, evaluate if caching belongs in commonlib, and whether the approach is developer-friendly. Later, after Copilot's own analysis showed minimal gains, maintainer questioned evidence of hot path.
review_details.performance_claim: Cache GetRuntimeData/GetVRRuntimeData calls to eliminate repeated pointer arithmetic and VR checks, improving frame performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after maintainer questioned evidence of hot path and Copilot's own analysis admitted minimal benefit; no benchmark or additional justification provided.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Optimization requiring deep understanding of underlying library (commonlib) and real-world profiling; Agent initially claimed performance gains but after investigation retracted, demonstrating the need for evidence before merging performance claims.

detection_detail.code_reading: alandtse reviewed the caching approach, questioned architecture, duplication, and later asked Copilot to examine commonlib implementation for actual savings.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling data, or before/after measurements; PR body only cited call counts and claimed elimination of virtual calls, but Copilot's analysis contradicted the claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED and subsequent investigation showing minimal gain, no further changes were made; PR closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: In src/Globals.h, added cached runtime data pointer declarations and inline accessor functions (globals::cached::GetRendererRuntimeData(), etc.). In src/Globals.cpp, initialized caches during ReInit(). Updated multiple source files to replace direct GetRuntimeData() calls with cached accessors.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Subsequent commits extended caching to depthStencilData and IsVR, and consolidated VR caching with existing static variable in State.cpp.
change_trajectory: First implementation: added caching for renderer, shadowState, graphicsState runtime data, updated several files.
Second commit: added caching for IsVR() and depthStencilData, updated more files.
Third commit: consolidated VR caching in State.cpp to use centralized globals::game::isVR.

review_signals.summary: Requested handling other similar examples, evaluate commonlib vs client app placement, and assess developer friendliness.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot expanded caching to more calls and consolidated VR caching.

review_signals.summary: Noted existing VR caching in State.cpp and asked to reconcile approaches.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot consolidated VR caching to centralized globals::game::isVR.

review_signals.summary: Asked Copilot to analyze commonlib implementation to determine real-world savings, implying skepticism of claimed benefits.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot analyzed and reported minimal performance gains.

review_signals.summary: Asked @doodlum for evidence that this was a hot path, referencing Copilot's analysis.
Added caching for IsVR and DepthStencilData, argued for client-app caching, but later conceded minimal performance benefit after analyzing commonlib.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue with initial caching implementation for runtime data.
alandtse CHANGES_REQUESTED asking to handle other similar examples, address architecture, and evaluate developer friendliness.
Copilot responded with expanded caching (IsVR, DepthStencilData) and argued caching should remain in client app.
